h: Vayechulu Unites the Avos and Renews the World With Kindness

p: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְגוֹמֵר (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב, א)
"And the heavens and the earth were completed," etc. (Bereishis 2:1).
and this is the secret of Shabbos:
the shin, which is Vayisa, Vayavo, Vayet,
which are included in the bas (daughter)," etc.
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
And this is as it says (Zohar II 204a):
is the secret of the three Avos
who are united in the only daughter,
and she is crowned with them."
And it says that these are Vayisa, Vayavo, Vayet,
from which the Name of seventy-two comes forth,
as is written in the Tikkunim (there and elsewhere).
וְאִיתָא בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב נב, א)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 52a):
the holy Name is engraved in its letters," etc.,
And it counts the pasuk Vayisa in order,
and the pasuk Vayavo in reverse,
and the pasuk Vayet in the secret of Tiferes;
And it says that corresponding to the Avos
it is written in Vayechulu three times
That is, the first time it says (Bereishis 2:2):
"And God completed on the seventh day,"
and it is stated in Abudarham
that this is why we say on Shabbos,
"The most desired of days You called it";
for through the day of Shabbos
all the work of the six days,
and all of Creation found favor before Him;
הַלְוַאי תְּהֵא מַעֲלִית חֵן לְפָנַי תָּמִיד
if only you would always find favor before Me
as you have found favor before Me
and behold, it was very good,"
עַל כָּל הַהֵיפֶךְ מֵהַטּוֹב גַּם כֵּן
as referring also to everything that is the opposite of good;
that from it there will come "very good."
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
except that which comes out of darkness,
except that which comes out of bad."
corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him;
for it is stated (Bereishis Rabbah 30:8 and elsewhere)
שֶׁבֶּן מ״ח שָׁנָה הִכִּיר אֶת בּוֹרְאוֹ
that at forty-eight years old he recognized his Creator,
"Perhaps you will say there is sin in my hand,
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to him:
לְךָ טַל יַלְדוּתֶךָ (תְּהִלִּים קי, ג) וְכוּלֵּי
"'Yours is the dew of your youth' (Tehillim 110:3)," etc.;
is a sign of blessing for the world," etc.
That is, from everything merits were made,
"Like these years that come in order
from the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow" (Yeshayahu 1:18).
And the dew alludes to the dew of Atika;
and he merited to be called "a native in Yisrael,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת תּוֹלְדוֹת)
as they said (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of Toldos, 63:3)
that Avraham, too, is called Yisrael.
וְכֹחַ זֶה יֵשׁ בִּקְדוּשַּׁת הַשַּׁבָּת גַּם כֵּן
And this power exists in the holiness of Shabbos as well,
to rectify all that has passed
that even one who worships idols like Enosh
וְאַף שֶׁאָז הוּחַל לִקְרוֹא בְּשֵׁם ה׳ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ד, כו)
and even though then "it became profane to call in the name of Hashem" (Bereishis 4:26),
and the profanation of the Name is the most severe
of the four divisions of atonement,
for which there is no power
nor in Yom Kippur to atone, etc.,
the holiness of Shabbos is effective
the holiness of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,

p: וַיִּשְׁבּוֹת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכׇּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב, ב)
"And He rested on the seventh day from all His work" (Bereishis 2:2):
from all His work for the future;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
whose middah is awe and dread
(and as written at the beginning of Orach Chaim),
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁנּוֹתֵן הָאָדָם אֶל לִבּוֹ
that when a person takes to heart
שֶׁמֶּלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that the King of kings, HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
stands over him and sees his deeds,
there will immediately come to him
from the dread of Hashem Yisbarach.
וְזֶה מִדַּת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is the middah of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
that the dread of Hashem stands before him always.
"That the fear of Heaven be upon you
like the fear of flesh and blood";
and his students said to him:
That is, is there not a level higher
than the fear of flesh and blood:
שֶׁיֵּדַע שֶׁמֶּלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that one should know that the King of kings, HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
stands over him and sees his deeds?
And he said to them, "If only," etc.;
that like the fear of flesh and blood
גַּם כֵּן טוֹב עַל כׇּל פָּנִים
is also good, at any rate;
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם יֵשׁ מַדְרֵגָה גָּבוֹהַּ מִזֶּה
yet nevertheless there is a level higher than this.
And this is the aspect of the Dread of Yitzchak;
and this a Jew merits on Shabbos,
for then Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name"
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned person."
And through this there is a rectification
that the evil inclination not prevail any more.
הוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him;
for all the blessings are included
in the blessings of life, children and sustenance,
is the first blessing in the Torah,
of the fish and of man:
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich,"
which is expounded in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 11:1)
And of life it is written (Shemos 23:25):
"And He will bless your bread and your water,
and I will remove illness from your midst," etc.
and mazal is the aspect of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי)
as is written in the holy Zohar (end of Parshas Acharei),
דְּמֵהַאי טַעְמָא כְּתִיב (שְׁמוּאֵל א א, י)
that for this reason it is written (Shmuel I 1:10):
הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל ה׳ יְהָבְךָ (תְּהִלִּים נה, כג)
which is the aspect of mazal,
which is the upper tip of the yud,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שָׁם סה, ב)
(as written in the holy Zohar there, Zohar III 65b).
And this is the meaning of what they said (Shabbos 156a):
that the middah of Ayin is the mazal of Yisrael.
are branches of the first three,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
וְכֵן הוּא בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב יד, ב)
And so it is in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 14b):
"He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah,
Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah,
Yaakov in the secret of Daas."
And Daas is the inwardness of Kesser Elyon,
which is the middah of Ayin;
of which "and He blessed" is written
הוּא נֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him.
And there is written in this also "and He sanctified it";
is the middah of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"And they will sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov."
And of the first three blessings of the Tefillah,
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 88a):
for Shabbos includes all the blessings,
since one merits then the holiness of the Avos
and the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is the root of all the blessings,
which depend on mazal, as mentioned above.
And blessing and holiness are one,

to sanctify him as holy of holies,"

p: And it further says in the Tikkunim (there):
"From the day the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed,
the world is called 'formless and void';
'I said, the world will be built with kindness';
chesed adds up to the number of the seventy-two Names."
וְהַיְינוּ עַל פִּי הַמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב)
That is, following the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 2:4),
"And the earth was formless and void,
and darkness upon the face of the deep,"
as referring to the four kingdoms.
And this is what it says, that at the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash
"the world is called formless and void,"
And afterward a new creation begins:
"the world will be built with kindness."
"And this is the morning of Avraham," etc.,
'And a throne will be established through kindness,'
and through it she will rise.
And the secret of the matter (Yeshayahu 54:8):
'And with everlasting kindness I have had mercy on you,'" etc.;
'As in the days of your going out of the land of Egypt
That is, just as at the Exodus from Egypt
there was a revelation of the aspect of Atika;
and therefore in the tenth plague
they were clarified through the middah of Kesser Elyon.
And likewise at the splitting of the Sea,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב נב, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 52b)
that the redemption from Egypt was through the Name of seventy-two.
And likewise the future redemption will be
and this is what is said:
which is the aspect of Atika,
when there is a revelation of Atika,
the holy Atika comes to dine with us,
which is "I said, the world will be built with chesed."
And it says that through this Chesed
the Throne, which is fallen, is established:
"And a throne will be established through kindness";
and sat upon His throne of glory";
for it is stated in the Mechilta
and Midrash Rabbah, Beshalach (beginning of parshah 23, Shemos Rabbah 23:1):
נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז וְכוּלֵּי (תְּהִלִּים צג, ב)
"'Your throne is established from then (me'az)' (Tehillim 93:2), etc.:
from when You stood at the Sea
and we sang a song before You with az,
And this follows what it says
and the alef bores through the darkness," etc.;
And with the revelation of the middah of Atika
and the Ancient of Days sat"
(and this has been explained several times).
And on Shabbos, when there is a revelation of the middah of Atika,
then "on the seventh day He ascended
and sat upon His throne of glory."
And this is what is said, "And a throne will be established through kindness,"
that the Throne which is fallen is established.
And this is why we begin Vayechulu
which is the union of hei with "sixth,"
the unification of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah,
and the unification comes only with the revelation of Atika;
"the world will be built with kindness,"
"and with everlasting kindness I have had mercy on you."
